verdict.rationale: Crossplane's own configuration is expressed as declarative, machine-readable APIs authored in YAML, KCL, Python or Go, and can be bundled as portable Configuration packages, so a user's definitions sit in open, committable formats (crossplane-docs-29, crossplane-docs-2, crossplane-docs-11, crossplane-comm-12). However, no first-party export or migration capability is documented. Missing for 10: an explicit documented export-all-data or offboarding workflow, coverage of managed-resource state and status beyond the config definitions, and independent hands-on confirmation of leaving cleanly.
